correctness.rationale: The formal binary-partition product B(x)=product_j(1-x^{2^j})^-2 satisfies B(x^2)=(1-x)^2B(x) and B(x)≡1+2x+5x² (mod 8) from a coefficientwise Mahler induction. Finite polynomial T(x)=product_{j=0}^6 (sum_{a=0}^{2^{7-j}-1}x^{a2^j})² has degree 1538, and B(x)=T(x)(1-x^128)^-14 B(x^128). Decimating yields T_r(y)B(y)/(1-y)^14. A complete finite coefficient certificate checks T_r identities for all r=0..127, exactly r=36,62 give identically 112 (mod 128) for every t>=0. Independent modular polynomial construction and first 120 decimated coefficients of all 128 classes confirmed exactly these two. Legendre: 112+128t=16(8t+7) never three squares. Two progressions give lower density 1/64 without existence of total obstruction density.
